prompt: In a vibrant anime style, the scene unfolds on a city rooftop at night where eighteen distinct elements coexist in a lively gathering. On the left, a girl with pink pigtails stands holding a glowing sparkler, her eyes wide with excitement as she looks at a boy in a blue hoodie who is laughing heartily beside her. The boy in the blue hoodie leans casually against a rusty ventilation unit, his hands tucked into his pockets. Next to him, a tabby cat sits calmly on a wooden crate, watching the festivities with narrowed eyes. In the center, a woman in a yellow dress raises a glass of soda high in the air, cheering towards a man in a black suit who is clapping his hands enthusiastically. The man in the black suit stands next to a large speaker that pulses with invisible rhythm. A girl with short green hair sits on the edge of the roof, dangling her legs over the side while looking down at the street lights below. Beside her, a golden retriever lies flat on the concrete, resting its chin on its paws. To the right, a chef in a white apron hands a slice of pizza to a teenager in a red cap, who reaches out eagerly to take it. The teenager in the red cap stands next to a stack of empty cardboard boxes. Behind them, an old man with a gray beard points toward the distant skyline, drawing the attention of a young woman in a purple kimono who turns her head to follow his gesture. The young woman in the purple kimono holds a paper fan loosely in one hand. Near the edge of the frame, a drone hovers silently, its red light blinking steadily. A bicycle leans against the wall nearby, its front wheel slightly bent. A stray pigeon perches on the handlebars of the bicycle, preening its feathers. A broken umbrella lies open on the ground near the center, its fabric torn. A lantern hangs from a wire above, casting a warm glow on the group. There is no rain falling from the sky. There is no music visible in the form of notes or instruments other than the speaker. There is no sun or moon visible in the background sky.
